Check cooling fan and screen for dust

 after 3000 running hours or 5 years).

Check main transformer
 and OLTC control cabinet connections tightness, space heater operation fan
 control operation,
 and temp. Setting adjustments, motor operating mechanism.

Use a water pressure to clean radiators and
 transformer tank, walls, unsealed wiring must be covered plastic to 
 avoid short circuit. It is recommended to use the transformer deluge system
 to perform cleaning operation, it will 
 provide a functioning test for the system at the same time.

Take and record insulation resistance readings and
 compare to the previous test and historical data.

Take and record cap. Dissipation factor, tans
 delta and compare to historical data.

Perform ratio test {lowest & highest and
 neutral tap position and compare to historical data.

Perform a complete tap changer OP. From highest to
 lowest step and back to the position it was found 
 in to clear all internal contacts of tap changer. (This step should be done
 every 3 Months)

Inspect condition of external tap changer drive
 shaft, tighten all coup lings and bolted connections.

Take and record final reading on tap changer
 operation counter.

Take oil sample for laboratory analysis and gas
 analysis each for both main and OLTC tanks.
